purpose: Convergenza delle tre firme del piano 2.5D (BOUNDARY_C3D.md F3): CM3D MotionPlane, CM3D Layer::is3D/flat() e C3D Camera2_5D + depth-plane DOF. Definisce SEMANTICA e mapping valico-per-valico; non e' una struct condivisa in codice. Nessun lato reimplementa le convenzioni dell'altro.

layer_flag.semantics: flat() == is3D == false marks a 2.5D plane layer: positioned in 3D, the thing it draws is a flat quad facing the camera. is3D == true is a fully 3D object and does NOT follow this contract.
layer_flag.mapping: Only plane layers (flat) are projected through the projection contract below; 3D objects follow the native 3D placement path.

authored_unit.size: Vector2, world-space size of the plane's box in motion units at scale 1; positive finite components.
authored_unit.anchor: Normalized pivot inside the box: (0,0) bottom-left .. (1,1) top-right; (0.5,0.5) is the center and the default for text and image planes.
authored_unit.depth: World Z of the plane in CM3D's authoring frame: a camera on +Z looking down -Z sees LARGER values as NEARER. This is an AUTHORING convention only; it is never compared directly against C3D values.
authored_unit.fittedWidth: The world width a fitted plane was built at (0 when sized explicitly); aspect re-derivation uses this, not the produced size.
authored_unit.sourceFingerprint: Measurement fingerprint the size/anchor were derived from; empty only for hand-built planes.

camera_space_contract.depth: Canonical crossing unit: camera-space Z AFTER the view transform (world_to_camera_space). positive = visible; visible <=> depth > near_epsilon. This is the ONLY depth meaning that crosses the boundary: MotionPlane.depth reaches it through view_matrix_for_camera, never as a raw world Z.
camera_space_contract.unset_semantics: depth <= near_epsilon means behind or on the camera plane (proj.visible == false). When !visible, centered/screen fields hold safe zero defaults and MUST never be projected as scene geometry; proj.visible is the single source of truth.

camera_defaults.position_note: screen-space world coordinates: 1000 units in front of the z=0 plane; the view transform maps world Z into the positive camera-space depth above.

bounds.lens_shift_unbounded: may exceed half the viewport to support off-screen framing

projection_contract.depth_equals_zoom: in Zoom mode, at depth == zoom the perspective_scale == 1

focal_rules.PhysicalLens: focal_xy derived from LensModel::focal_xy_pixels (honors pixel_aspect and anamorphic_squeeze on focal_x); degenerate lens falls back to zoom

projection_contract.per_axis_scaling: For Fill/Overscan spherical lens with square pixels focal_x == focal_y. For GateFit::Stretch or anamorphic lenses focal_x != focal_y: callers MUST apply per-axis scale (scale_x = focal_x_px / depth, scale_y = focal_y_px / depth) so aspect ratio is preserved on the canvas.
projection_contract.single_projector_rule: All four projection paths (project_world_point, project_layer_2_5d, make_projection_context, project_2_5d) route through focal_xy_from_camera before any scale = focal / depth math; there is exactly one projector.

dof_depth_plane_contract.unit: positive camera-space optical depth, same depth as camera_space_contract.depth
dof_depth_plane_contract.semantics: kUnsetDofDepth is stored in the per-pixel DOF depth plane when no visible surface contributed to a pixel. Zero is NOT a valid positive camera-space optical depth and must never be reused to mean unset.
dof_depth_plane_contract.shaped_bokeh: iris_blades and highlight_gain remain fail-closed on every render path (BOUNDARY_C3D.md C3); this contract does not extend them.

convergence_rules: The authored unit is unique: CM3D owns plane authoring (MotionPlane, Layer::flat()); C3D owns projection and DOF depth semantics. No second model is created on the other side.
Fail-closed ranges are identical on both sides; a payload outside the declared bounds is rejected, never clamped silently.
The mapping between CM3D world Z and C3D camera-space depth exists only through the view transform of camera_projection_contract.hpp.
Any change to these conventions is made in this contract file first, in the same change that touches either side.
